content_pipeline: Horizontal dual-track convergence diagram. Top track: Git bundles flow through the content loader into canonical lessons. Bottom track: Supabase RLS user rows flow through scoped queries into personal study state. Both tracks remain isolated sources of truth and converge inside the Next.js Lesson Page.
illustration_system: Horizontal build-time pipeline. One TSX illustration source passes through the Satori and Resvg raster builder to generate paired dark and light PNG previews (*_dark.png and *_light.png). The client renderer swaps between the two URLs by active theme without rebuilding on the server.
